newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 3.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China will this year promulgate four new laws concerning financial markets, including a law on investment funds.

- The Shanghai branch of the People's Bank of China, the central bank, will this year strengthen supervision of financial institutions in the city by conducting more detailed probes into their financial results in a bid to increase risk control.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai now has direct air links with 17 countries, becoming the Chinese city with the second most foreign air links after Beijing.
- A commentary warns that the large-scale dismissal of workers will not help if the state enterprises involved do not improve their management.
